text: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', e.CLOSE_DATE) AS close_month, COUNT(DISTINCT e.OPPORTUNITY_ID) AS lost_opportunities_count, SUM(e.AMOUNT) AS lost_amount FROM OFFICE_DW.SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED e JOIN OFFICE_DW.SFDC.OPPORTUNITY o ON o.ID = e.OPPORTUNITY_ID WHERE e.IS_CLOSED = 1 AND e.IS_WON = 0 AND e.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND LOWER(o.COMPETITOR_C) = 'splunk' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', e.CLOSE_DATE) ORDER BY close_month ASC LIMIT 500
